ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(CONTAINS($Label.Validation_exempted_Users, $User.Username)), NOT(ISCHANGED(SkipValidations__c)), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Quotation Phase')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Account.TypeOfBusiness__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Account.SalesCategory__c, "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the information for "Business Type" and "Sales Category". This data can be entered under "Account Information" in the "Details" tab.
